title: StockSmart Account Management Questions — Ship-To Age and the Site Share on Opening Consigned Stock
content:
**Rule.** For the opening consigned stock of a new StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program consigned bin that takes over an item taken out of one of the customer's VendPoint machines, the age in whole months of the program's ship-to, from the date it was opened to today, puts a site share into the carried share: below 6 months puts 0.7, 6 to 11 months puts 0.9, and 12 months or more puts no site share in; a ship-to with no opening date on record counts as opened today.

**Q. Which date is read?** The opening date of the program's ship-to as its Ship-To Fulfillment Account records it.

**Q. How are whole months counted?** The number of calendar months from the opening date to today, less one when today's day of the month is earlier than the opening date's day of the month.

**Q. Hypothetically, a ship-to opened on 20 January, today 19 July?** Six calendar months, less one because the 19th is earlier than the 20th: 5 months, below 6, so 0.7. On 20 July it is 6 months, so 0.9.

**Q. A ship-to opened on 5 March of last year, today 5 March?** 12 months: no site share.

**Q. No opening date on record?** It counts as opened today, 0 months, so 0.7.

| Whole months since the ship-to opened | Site share |
|---|---|
| 0 to 5 | 0.7 |
| 6 to 11 | 0.9 |
| 12 or more | none put in |
